chains.description: After rotating a credential, follow revoke-access to invalidate the superseded grant.
After deploying a service, follow purge-cache so stale entries are not served.
After handling a refund, follow reconcile-invoice so the ledger agrees.
Onboarding a vendor transitively requires provisioning its account and then granting access (3-hop).

scenarios.description: A credential must be rotated during a maintenance window.
A new service version is promoted to production.
A customer refund is processed end to end.
A new vendor is onboarded with account and access.
